detail.longDescription: "What happens when AI agents start relying on the same messy docs your team already struggles to search? Demetrios hops into a Waymo in San Francisco with Dave Nuñez, founder and CEO of Falconer and co-author of Documentation for Developers. They talk about why developers and agents need different things from docs, why agents sometimes skip up-to-date instructions, and how a stale internal document can contribute to a production incident. Dave shares how Stripe cut roughly 500,000 internal docs down to 5,000 worth maintaining. The conversation also covers how to capture the reasoning behind engineering decisions, when a diagram beats a wall of text, and who owns the fallout when an agent acts on bad information." https:// home.mlops.community/public/vi deos/why-stripe-cut-500000-internal-docs-down-to-5000 # TechnicalWriting # Documentation # SoftwareDocumentation # AI # AIAgents # GenerativeAI # LLMs
